name: Wood Woad

actions.name: Shield Bash
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be knocked prone and have -1d6 to their next attack.

actions.name: Tree Stride
actions.effect: The Wood Woad steps into one tree and emerges from another within 18m. Can then make a Club attack as part of this action.

reactions.name: Wooden Shield
reactions.effect: Raises its bark shield, adding +4 to physical defense against one attack.

reactions.name: Nature's Vengeance
reactions.effect: When an ally plant creature within 6m is damaged, the Wood Woad can immediately move half its speed and make a Club attack against the attacker.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: Regains 5 HP at start of each turn while in contact with the ground in a natural area. Does not function if the Wood Woad took fire damage last turn.

traits.name: Plant Camouflage
traits.desc: In forested or heavily vegetated areas, the Wood Woad is nearly invisible (+2d6 to stealth).

traits.name: Nature Bound
traits.desc: The Wood Woad is bound to a specific forest. If it leaves, it loses its Regeneration trait.

lore: Wood Woads are fey-touched plant warriors created when a mortal pledges their life to protect a forest. They are reborn as living wood, eternally guarding their sacred grove. They are skilled fighters who use the trees themselves to ambush intruders.
